description: FAULT-S4-005 Step-3 full-ledger EVIDENCE-BAR audit — shrink-only remediation register for pre-existing provenance_kind:proof anchors that do NOT carry their proof evidence (proof_state:verified + a language-clean verification.axiom_closure + sorry_count:0 + a resolving, sorry-free proof_file). Enumerated by the audit's first run: 10 of 31 proof anchors carried strong evidence; 21 did not (phantom: no proof_file; no-audit: file resolves but written/no verification). FULLY BURNED DOWN: 17 via #621 (6 proof + 11 derivation) and 4 via #613 (42zd recovered as proof after the Sedenion native_decide split; hessian->internal-compute; fano->theory/killed; shells->derivation). Register is now EMPTY — the shrink-only mechanism stays in place to block any NEW over-claim. Resolution per entry (theory-state — oppenheimer + cth, 1x1): PROVE (supply a verified, axiom-clean proof) or RECLASSIFY. Either resolution REMOVES the entry.
policy: SHRINK-ONLY. The full-ledger evidence-bar audit (scripts/check_anchor_manifest.py) HARD-FAILS if: (1) any provenance_kind:proof anchor FAILS the evidence bar and is NOT listed here (a NEW over-claim — blocked immediately: you cannot claim proven without submitting the evidence); or (2) a listed anchor now MEETS the bar (it was proved/verified — remove the stale entry). The register can only lose entries. Adding an entry is a visible, reviewed commit to this file with a tracking issue — NOT a silent CI-driven baseline raise (that silent-raise is exactly what defeated the FAULT-S4-005 ratchet). This register is a burn-down list on the clock, not a permanent allowlist.
